neighbours.label: A token that announces a specification or elaboration of what was just said (':' after 'two parts', ', principalmente,', ', you know,', 'En primer lugar'), in English and Spanish; the same content with no such turn stays quiet.
fire: The exam has three sections: reading, writing and math.
The report covers two topics: cost and safety.
Eat simple foods (you know, like a pear) at lunch.
Se centran en varios países, principalmente, en Francia y España.
Es barato, es rápido, pero lo mejor, es que funciona.
En primer lugar, el precio es bajo.
Todo funciona bien, sobre todo, en verano.
There is a class for every student, except one group… those who work nights.
quiet: The exam has three sections and ends at noon.
The report covers two years of cost data.
Eat simple foods at lunch every day.
Se centran en varios países de Europa.
Es barato y rápido y funciona.
El precio es bajo en este lugar.
There is a class for every student in the school.

notes: Probes: 0.26-0.92, but a plain Spanish sentence read 0.32 on ' más', so Spanish may leak. The output direction suppresses ' especially', ' particularly', ' so', which suggests the pole marks a slot other than those words.
